footnote_text: Consists of restricted stock units ("RSUs"). Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's Common Stock. The RSU is subject to service-based vesting requirements and vests with respect to 12.5% of the RSUs on the six-month anniversary of September 4, 2026, and in seven equal semi-annual installments thereafter, subject to Reporting Person's continuous service through each applicable vesting date.
